verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a UI framework for building web interfaces, not an agent or tool-using application, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from MCP servers is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Vue shipping MCP client capability. The llms.txt documentation is about serving docs to LLMs, not about consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
